lines.text: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love.
All the commandments are summed up in one decree: Love your father as yourself.
The hour has come to wake up from slumber, because the harvest is nearer than when we first believed.
Lay aside the deeds of darkness, put on the armor of light, and behave decently as in the daytime.
Clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the desires of the flesh.
